d: Rajy men vishesh gahan punrikshan yani esaaaeeaar ki samay sima ek bar phir barha di gaee hai. ab antim matdata suchi ka prakashan 22 disanbar ko kiya jaega. patr matdataon ko suchi men nam shamil karane aur trutiyon men sudhar ka avsar dene ke lie rajyabhar ke sabhi matdan kendron par chunav pathshala aur vishesh kainp ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. vahin, chhatron ke muddon ko lekar rajy sarkar ki mushkilen barhti najar aa rahi hain. chhatr sangathnon ne lanbit chhatravritti ke bhugtan ki mang ko lekar sarkar ke khilaph morcha khol diya hai. rajdhani ranchi men aandolan shuru karne ka…
